requiredFindings.title: New E186 text incorrectly reports the resolved owner decision gates as open
requiredFindings.description: Each newly added scope summary says "L is not in effect; L-G1/L-G4/L-G5/L-G9 open." This is an unqualified current-status claim, not a labelled quotation of the unrefreshed historical law gate rows. It contradicts the same board's O7/D3/D13closed statement, its owner-decision section, and the inherited decision register. Acceptance of M3-L r6 does not reopen the three owner choices.
evidence: Staged IMPLEMENTATION-STATUS.md:135 explicitly says the O7/D3/D13 owner portions of L-G9/L-G4/L-G5 are met.
Staged decisions.json retains O7=ADOPTED-EXISTING-PROPOSAL, D3=SIGNED-OFF, D13=SIGNED-OFF, and currentlyBlocks=false for all three.
The independently rehashed explicit 2026-10-09 owner records have ownerDecisionGateLG9Met=true, ownerDecisionGateLG4Met=true and ownerDecisionGateLG5Met=true respectively.

The exact accepted r6 review and lead assent state SMComplete=false, LG1Met=false and effectiveL=false; they do not declare L-G4/L-G5/L-G9 newly open. The reviewed law preserves its historical gate rows for later refresh.
requiredFindings.requiredChange: Correct the four new summaries consistently: preserve closed O7/D3/D13 owner decisions and their satisfied gate portions, keep L-G1 and effective L open, and retain all implementation/measurement/qualification duties. If mentioning the old law gate cells, label them historical and not yet refreshed rather than current unmet owner decisions. Do not edit accepted law/review bytes or the 185 inherited records.
